# Tasks: Integration Soak Bundle (016 phase wrap-up)

**Input**: Design documents from `specs/019-integration-soak-bundle/`
**Prerequisites**: spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/gate-commands.md, quickstart.md

**Tests**: This spec ships no new code. The "tests" are the existing test suites run as the gate (G-FULL-*); they are not generated by this task list. The contract gate commands document the exact invocations.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (P1 green ship, P2 bisect on failure, P3 rebase on overrun). Phase 1 is pre-flight setup; Phase 2 is per-branch standalone-build verification (foundational gate before any merge); Phases 3–5 cover the three user stories; Phase 6 is post-soak cleanup.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Parallel-eligible (independent inputs, different log files / different branches)
- **[Story]**: User story label (US1 = green ship, US2 = bisect, US3 = rebase)
- File paths refer to operational artifacts: `logs/*.log`, branch refs, PR references

## Path Conventions

- All commands run from repo root (`/mnt/D/repos/mentoory-ps`)
- Logs land under `logs/` (created in T001) — gitignored, attached to the bundle PR
- Branch refs:
  - Spec branch: `019-integration-soak-bundle` (currently checked out — DO NOT modify during execution)
  - Integration branch: `019-integration-soak` (created in T010, deleted in T036)
  - Source branches: `origin/016-{registration-access-hardening,project-lifecycle-finish,audit-pipeline,knowledge-module-core}` — frozen for the duration

## Phase 4: User Story 2 — Bundle fails the gate; bisect identifies the regression owner (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: On gate failure, bisect by reverting in reverse order until the gate goes green again, then ship the partial bundle with the regression-owning branch routed back to its PR.

**Independent Test**: Inject a known regression on one branch, run the bundle, confirm bisect identifies the correct branch and produces a green partial bundle.

**Trigger**: any of T023–T026 fails AND EC-5 flake handling (re-run once) confirms it's a real regression.

### Implementation for User Story 2

- [ ] T036 [US2] Identify the failing gate step from Phase 3 logs. Record in `logs/bisect-trigger.txt` which step failed and the failure mode (test name, error message).
- [ ] T037 [US2] Bisect iteration 1 — revert knowledge merge (G-BISECT-1): `git revert -m 1 HEAD --no-edit` (HEAD is knowledge merge commit). Re-run the failing gate step from T036. Capture results in `logs/bisect-1-rerun.log`. If green: knowledge owns the regression — terminate bisect, proceed to T041. If still red: continue to T038.
- [ ] T038 [US2] Bisect iteration 2 — revert audit merge (G-BISECT-2): identify audit's merge SHA via `git log --merges --oneline | head -10`, run `git revert -m 1 <audit-merge-sha> --no-edit`. Re-run failing gate step. Capture in `logs/bisect-2-rerun.log`. If green: audit owns the regression — terminate, proceed to T041. If still red: continue to T039.
- [ ] T039 [US2] Bisect iteration 3 — revert lifecycle merge (G-BISECT-3): `git revert -m 1 <lifecycle-merge-sha> --no-edit`. Re-run failing gate step. Capture in `logs/bisect-3-rerun.log`. If green: lifecycle owns the regression — terminate, proceed to T041. If still red: continue to T040.
- [ ] T040 [US2] Bisect iteration 4 — revert registration merge (G-BISECT-4): `git revert -m 1 <registration-merge-sha> --no-edit`. Re-run failing gate step. Capture in `logs/bisect-4-rerun.log`. If green: registration owns the regression. **If still red after all four reverts**: integration branch ≡ origin/develop; the failure is on develop or in the conflict-resolution work, NOT in any single source branch. Abort bundle: skip to T044.
- [ ] T041 [US2] Record bisect outcome in `logs/bisect-result.txt`: which branch(es) were reverted, which gate step failed, full failure log excerpt. Single regression owner = the most recently reverted branch that turned the gate green.
- [ ] T042 [US2] Re-run full gate (G-FULL-*) on the reverted integration branch to confirm it's still green for the remaining branches (T023–T026 again, with new logs `logs/gate-unit-rerun.log`, etc.). Pass = all green for the partial bundle.
- [ ] T043 [US2] Ship partial bundle: continue with T028 (bundle PR body — adjusted to mention which branch was reverted), T029 (open bundle PR), T030 (attach evidence including bisect logs), T031 (review), T032 (merge), T033 (close source PRs — but DO NOT close the regression-owning branch's PR; instead post a comment on it with the bisect evidence and leave open), T034 (delete integration branch), T035 (local cleanup).
- [ ] T044 [US2] Abort path (only reached from T040 "all four reverted, still red"): post comments on all 4 source PRs explaining the bundle was aborted with bisect results; delete integration branch from origin (`git push origin --delete 019-integration-soak`); investigate develop separately. Do NOT open the bundle PR.

**Checkpoint:** either partial bundle shipped (Tasks T043) or bundle aborted (T044). In both cases, the regression-owning PR(s) have detailed comments explaining the failure mode for follow-up.

## Phase 5: User Story 3 — Soak exceeds one working day; rebase on develop (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: If the soak runs >24h wall-clock, rebase the integration branch on the latest origin/develop and re-run the full gate before shipping.

**Independent Test**: Simulate a develop commit during the soak; confirm the rebase resolves cleanly and a fresh gate run produces fresh evidence.

**Trigger**: NFR-001 24-hour wall-clock threshold exceeded between integration branch creation (T010) and bundle PR open (T029).

### Implementation for User Story 3

- [ ] T045 [US3] Pull latest develop: `git checkout 019-integration-soak && git fetch origin develop`
- [ ] T046 [US3] Rebase on origin/develop: `git rebase origin/develop`. Resolve any new conflicts (likely on files that develop has touched since T010). Capture conflict files and resolutions in `logs/rebase-conflicts.txt`.
- [ ] T047 [US3] Re-run full gate end-to-end after rebase: re-execute T023 (unit), T024 (integration), T025 (E2E), T026 (DACPAC), T027 (coverage-check), capturing fresh logs as `logs/gate-*-postrebase.log`. The pre-rebase logs are now stale and should NOT be used as ship evidence.
- [ ] T048 [US3] Update bundle PR body to note the rebase + re-gate cycle: add a section "Soak extension" with the rebase date, the new develop SHA the integration branch was rebased onto, and a link to the post-rebase gate logs.
- [ ] T049 [US3] Continue with T028 onward using post-rebase logs as the canonical ship evidence.

**Checkpoint:** bundle either ships with documented rebase evidence (continuing US1 from T028) or, if the post-rebase gate fails, falls into US2 (bisect) using post-rebase logs as the failure trigger.

## Dependencies

```
Phase 1 Setup (T001-T005)
    ↓
Phase 2 Foundational standalone builds (T006-T009 [P])
    ↓
Phase 3 US1 happy path (T010 → T011→T012→T013→T014→T015→T016→T017→T018→T019→T020→T021 → T022 → T023/T024/T025/T026 [P] → T027 → T028→T029→T030→T031→T032→T033→T034→T035)
    ↓ (gate fail, EC-5 confirmed)
Phase 4 US2 bisect (T036 → T037 → T038? → T039? → T040? → T041 → T042 → T043 OR T044)
    ↓ (24h wall-clock exceeded at any point in Phase 3)
Phase 5 US3 rebase (T045 → T046 → T047 → T048 → T049 → returns to T028)
    ↓
Phase 6 Polish (T050-T055)
```

**Story dependencies**:
- US1 requires Phase 1 + Phase 2 complete
- US2 only triggers from US1 gate failure (T023/T024/T025/T026)
- US3 only triggers from soak duration overrun (cross-cuts Phase 3, 4, or 5)
- Phase 6 polish requires US1 (or US2 partial-ship) to have shipped a bundle to develop

**Within US1 sequential dependencies**:
- T010 → T011 (must have integration branch before merging)
- T011 → T012 (build check after each merge)
- T012 → T013 (next merge requires green build)
- T013 → T014 → T015 → T016 → T017 → T018 → T019 → T020 → T021 (sequential merge chain with build checks)
- T021 → T022 (push only after all merges land cleanly)
- T022 → T023, T024, T025, T026 (parallelizable test phases)
- T023 ∧ T024 ∧ T025 ∧ T026 → T027 (capture coverage-check after build is settled)
- T027 → T028 (PR body needs all evidence)
- T028 → T029 → T030 → T031 → T032 → T033 → T034 → T035 (PR open → review → merge → cleanup)

**Within US2 sequential dependencies**:
- T036 → T037 → T038 → T039 → T040 (sequential reverts; each iteration depends on the prior gate result)
- T037/T038/T039/T040 (whichever turns green) → T041 → T042 → T043
- T040 (still red after all 4 reverts) → T044

## Parallel Execution Opportunities

**Phase 1**: T003 ∥ T004 (PR-state check and Docker check are independent)

**Phase 2**: T006 ∥ T007 ∥ T008 ∥ T009 — all four standalone builds run independently (use git worktrees or sequential checkouts; logs to different files)

**Phase 3 (US1) gate**: T023 ∥ T024 ∥ T025 ∥ T026 — unit / integration / E2E / DACPAC publish are all independent. Recommended: run in parallel via 4 terminals or use a runner like `parallel`. Wall-clock target: max(unit, integration, E2E, DACPAC) ≈ 7 min instead of sum ≈ 10 min.

**Other phases**: largely sequential by nature (merges, bisect iterations, ship steps).

---

## Implementation Strategy

**MVP scope = User Story 1 only** (Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3 + Phase 6).

This is the green-path bundle ship. If executed cleanly, it ships all four features in ~3.5–6 hours of wall-clock (per quickstart.md time budget).

**Incremental delivery options:**

- **MVP only (US1)**: ship the bundle on the first try. No US2 / US3 needed. ~70% probability based on the conflict surface analysis.
- **MVP + US2 (bisect on failure)**: ship a partial bundle if one branch carries a regression. Adds ~30–60 min per bisect iteration (max 4 iterations). Required if US1 gate fails.
- **MVP + US3 (rebase on overrun)**: only if soak exceeds 24h wall-clock. Adds ~30 min for rebase + ~15 min for re-gate.

**MVP + US2 + US3** is the worst-case path. Even there, total wall-clock fits within the NFR-001 1-day soft target (per the time budget table in `quickstart.md`).

## Format Validation
